errors.evidence: (After careful search I obtained that the maximum worst-case win is 16 coins, corresponding to $16,000.)
errors.description: The agent hallucinates a final answer in its thought process before it has run the code to calculate it. The hallucinated value of $16,000 is incorrect, as the subsequent code execution correctly determines the answer to be $10,000.

While it ultimately relied on the tool's correct output, this internal contradiction makes the process unreliable.
